elements.title: a duel against each other (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that in 1809, two ministers leading the British war effort against Napoleon fought a duel against each other?

elements.title: Lou Rash (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that in his first year in the NFL, Lou Rash was told he was released and began flying back home, but was told upon landing that the release was a mistake and he was to return?

elements.title: muthkwey (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that muthkwey was not harvested or walked over, because oral tradition held that it had grown from the droppings of a two-headed serpent?

elements.title: Al-Altan (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that the Mongol princess Al-Altan was rumoured to have poisoned her brother Ögedei Khan?

elements.title: Saybrook Colony (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that the Saybrook Colony was sold to Connecticut for an annual payment of 180 pounds of equal quantities of wheat, peas, and either rye or barley?

elements.title: Chiu Yuh-chuan (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that future Olympic weightlifter Chiu Yuh-chuan received a job offer in marketing after media coverage about his difficulty securing employment?

elements.title: 1957 Manipur Territorial Council election (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that out of 148 candidates in the 1957 Manipur Territorial Council election there was only one woman?

elements.title: Trisha Stafford-Odom (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that basketball coach Trisha Stafford-Odom left the Eagles to join the Eagles?
